notes: Sources: one usable source, 2018_01_faculty_manual_2017_18 (University of Miami Faculty Manual 2017-2018, 'updated through 1 June 17', effective 6/1/2017), the governing faculty handbook for tenure-stream (REGULAR) faculty on the reference date 2018-03-13.

Governing provision: Faculty Manual C17.7 'Faculty Parental Leave and Workload Relief' (#2001-27(B), #2006-02(B)), with C5.5 probationary-period extensions. The one pending legislation shown in the Manual (#2016-59(A), limits on promotion re-requests) does not touch leave.

Birth parent chain (primary caregiver certified): paid parental leave 8 weeks (c1; FMLA c3 concurrent from week 0, 12 weeks) -> own-balance parental leave up to 4 weeks (c2, consecutive_after c1; inside FMLA) ; workload relief either for the semester of the birth containing the leave (c4, c1 within c4) or, when the birth or leave end falls between semesters, the following semester after the leave (c5, consecutive_after c2); c4, c5 and the half-relief option c6 are in_lieu_of each other (R15b, longest counts).

Non-birth parent chain: identical to the birth parent's (all C17.7 benefits are gender-neutral and conditioned on certified primary care responsibility, read as gender-neutral under R6): paid parental leave 8 -> own-balance up to 4 (FMLA alongside, 12) ; workload relief c4 (containing the leave) or c5 (after the leave) or c6 (half relief), in_lieu_of.

Workload relief timing (C17.7 para. 8) coded as two timing alternatives (c4 birth-semester relief containing the leave, R3b; c5 following-semester relief after the leave, R3d), as in R15b's Tufts example; the link of c5 is to the end of the parental leave including the 4 own-balance weeks (R15, last leave taken).

Eligibility: REGULAR faculty with appointments of at least .50 FTE are eligible for the C17.7 benefits 'upon employment' (no service requirement); research faculty, UMMG members, instructors and full-time lecturers need 24 consecutive months (U8: not the coded member's path). UMMG members' pay rate is a 12-month average of compensation (not main-campus).

Not components: sabbatical leave (C16; for research, writing or other academic activity, not usable for a birth); leave for political activity (AAUP statement; political purpose); 'Illness or Other Emergency' (reporting duty only, no leave).

Cross-references not saved: the University policy for the use of sick time (sick-leave accrual terms; C17.7 para. 5); the 'appropriate policies' for disability leave (C5.5(a)); the long-term disability plan on the Benefits Administration website (C17.3); FMLA detail held by the Office of Faculty Affairs. No sick-leave accrual provision is in the Manual, so sick leave appears only as the funding of c2.
No combined leave-time cap and no all-sources paid cap is stated; no use limit is stated for any component.
